notes: control: 5 yr of real weather, not labelled offline — the detector refuses, so the passes above mean something
stuck run: deadline fired, 1 message swallowed, 1 fresh worker(s) built for the retry
stale inputs: settled on 27 kWh/day; the rendered payload's share hash reads 27.4 kWh/day, so the screen belongs to the newer run
share restore: a link produced by a real run restored 14 kWh/day and still runs on an explicit click
scope_limit: one unthrottled Chrome, one city, five injected transport failures plus a control, and one silent-worker deadline. The 45s weather abort is NOT browser-exercised: it is armed inside the sizing worker's realm, which a page-realm timer shim cannot reach, so the budget arithmetic for it is a source-level invariant over the constants the modules export. No device matrix, no CPU or network throttling, no load test.
enforcement: blocking from P0: a measured defect, a stage that did not run, a stage that ran and intercepted nothing, and an inner budget that does not fit its outer cap
facet_line: ADVERSARIAL, 1 Chrome, 1 city: 5 failures degrade alike, control clean; silent worker trips the page deadline; inner budgets fit their outer caps (tightest slack 135s). Budget arithmetic is source-level: worker-realm timers cannot be shortened from the page. No device matrix.
